questions.source: Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix · Practice Questions (Question Set II) Q110
questions.question_en:
Assertion: The Governor shall hold office during the pleasure of the President.
Reason: The Governor of a state shall be appointed by the President India.
options_en: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not a correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.answer_source: Printed answer key in the Laxmikanth appendix (copied unchanged)
questions.explanation_en: ⚠ Disputed book key. Book key 1. Both A and R are true, but tenure at the President's pleasure flows from Article 156(1), not from the fact of appointment under Article 155; option 2 is arguably more accurate.
questions.explanation_te: ⚠ పుస్తక కీ వివాదాస్పదం. పుస్తక కీ 1. A, R రెండూ సరైనవే; కానీ రాష్ట్రపతి ప్రసాదపర్యంతం పదవిలో ఉండటం ప్రకరణ 156(1) నుంచి వస్తుంది, ప్రకరణ 155 కింద నియామకం నుంచి కాదు; కాబట్టి 2 మరింత కచ్చితం.

questions.source: Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix · Practice Questions (Question Set II) Q131
questions.question_en:
Statement-I: The Governor is de-jure head of state administration.
Statement-II: The Chief Minister is de-facto head of state administration.
options_en: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.answer_source: Printed answer key in the Laxmikanth appendix (copied unchanged)
questions.explanation_en: ⚠ Disputed book key. Book key 1. Both statements are true, but Statement II is the other half of the de jure/de facto contrast, not an explanation of Statement I; option 2 is arguably more accurate.
questions.explanation_te: ⚠ పుస్తక కీ వివాదాస్పదం. పుస్తక కీ 1. రెండు వాక్యాలూ సరైనవే; కానీ రెండో వాక్యం మొదటి వాక్యానికి వివరణ కాదు, నామమాత్ర (de jure)/వాస్తవ (de facto) పోలికలోని మరో భాగం మాత్రమే; కాబట్టి 2 మరింత కచ్చితం.
